en:
I know why you've coooome...
You're here to invite me, right?

Atua said that Shuichi would come soon
to invite me.
Yah-ha! Did you come to invite me?

Atua has spoken...
Shuichi should spend time with me.
Perfect timing! I was looking for you!
Spend time together
Never mind
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>What would you like to do with Angie?
Spend time together
Go on a date
Never mind
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>What would you like to do with Angie?

Atua tells me when deliveries will arrive, or
when baseball games will go into overtime.

Nyahahaha! Hearing the voice of Atua
is so convenient!

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time talking to Angie
about Atua and his good works.
Do you wanna hear Atua's voice too, Shuichi?
Then let's pray to Atua first.
<CLT=cltMIND>I prayed to Atua with Angie...

Huh? Why not?
Atua said so.
It would make me so happy if you drew me.

Nyahahaha! I'm always the one doing the drawing!
Being drawn is kinda embarrassing!
<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time drawing Angie.
Well, what should we do?
Wanna ask Atua?
Or do you wanna decide yourself, Shuichi?

Nyahaha! I wonder how we should decide on
what to decide on.

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time thinking about
deciding on what to decide on...
<CLT=cltMIND>Angie and I grew a little closer today.
